basics.name: Ananya Rao
basics.label: Backend Developer (Python)
basics.summary: Backend developer with three years of experience building REST APIs in Python and FastAPI, with a focus on PostgreSQL data modelling, background jobs and test coverage.

projects.name: Inventory Service
projects.description: REST API for tracking stock across warehouses for a small electronics retailer.
highlights: Designed the PostgreSQL schema and Alembic migrations for products, warehouses and stock movements
Cut the low-stock report from 9 s to 60 ms by replacing per-product queries with one aggregate query
Kept test coverage above 90% with pytest and a disposable Postgres container in CI

projects.name: Async Report Builder
projects.description: Background job system that renders CSV and PDF reports on demand.
highlights: Moved report generation off the request path with Celery workers and Redis
Added idempotency keys so retried jobs never produce duplicate reports

projects.name: Link Shortener
projects.description: Personal URL shortener with click analytics.
highlights: Base62 short codes with collision checks
